narr: Rainfall from Tropical Storm Henri resulted in widespread flash flooding across portions of northeast New Jersey With a tropical airmass in place (precipitable water values greater than 2 inches), rainfall totals generally ranged from 2-4 inches, with this rain coming in addition to the 1-3 inches that fell during the predecessor rainfall event the night before. This resulted in widespread rainfall amounts of 3-7 inches in many locations over a 24-36 hour period. The ASOS at Newark Airport recorded a total of 4.67 inches across the two days, while the COOP observer in Harrison reported a two day total of 8.02 inches.
ev: The Molly Ann Brook at North Haledon rose above minor flood stage (6.0 feet) at 5:50pm EDT August 22, quickly crested at a height of 6.99 feet at 6:25pm EDT, and fell back below flood stage at 7:20pm EDT.
Forest Avenue was closed due to flooding between Dean Street and Van Brunt Street in Englewood.
There were 3 to 4 feet of water in the basement of a home in Haskell.
There were several feet of water in the basement of a home in Hewitt.
Pascack Road was closed due to flooding between Washington Avenue and Freemont Avenue in Woodcliff Lake.
Police were dispatched to a home in West Milford due to a report of water entering the property through the windows and doors.
Marshall Hill Road was closed due to flooding between Coolidge Terrace and the Agape Childcare Center in West Milford.
Cherry Lane in Upper Saddle River was closed due to flooding.
